# LS25 / FS25 Modding Guide

> Practical, verified knowledge for writing Farming Simulator 25 (LS25, FS25, GIANTS Engine 10) Lua script mods: shop configurations, motor/gearbox changes, settings menus, HUD, wear and repair, used vehicle market, leasing, helpers (AI workers), AutoDrive/Courseplay interop, input, dashboards, economy (money bookings, selling prices, contracts, storages), debugging and multiplayer events, plus a compatibility table of popular mods. Every statement is marked as confirmed in game, read from the game source, learned from another mod, or assumption. Includes a translation checker, a test runner and a small mod template.

Read `knowledge/INDEX.md` first to find the file for a game function or class name, then read only that file. Status markers: ✅ confirmed in game, 📖 game source, 🔎 other mod, ❓ assumption.

## Knowledge
- [API index](knowledge/INDEX.md): game function/class/global name -> file
- [1. Sources and tools](knowledge/01-sources-and-tools.md): game source repos, reference mods, log.txt, mock tests, DDS icons
- [2. Mod skeleton](knowledge/02-mod-skeleton.md): modDesc descVersion 113, loader with source(), lifecycle hooks (Mission00.load, FSBaseMission.delete), Utils.overwrittenFunction, specialization injection via TypeManager.validateTypes, spec table alias, removeEventListener, savegame keys vehicles.vehicle(?).modName.specName, l10n and global g_i18n, help pages
- [3. Settings and menu](knowledge/03-settings-and-menu.md): savegame settings file, modSettings, g_currentModSettingsDirectory, XMLFile/XMLSchema, own tab in InGameMenuSettingsFrame, options built in Lua, InGameMenu page, MessageDialog, g_gui:loadGui, focus, presets
- [4. Configurations and shop](knowledge/04-configurations-and-shop.md): addConfigurationType, getConfigurationsFromXML, XMLFile.initInheritance injection ($pdlcdir$), DLC vehicle keys, SHOP_CONFIG, ShopConfigScreen hooks, BuyVehicleEvent/BuyVehicleData, SellVehicleEvent, leasing costs, buying out, addMoney vs changeBalance, MoneyType.register, workshop buttons
- [5. Motor and gearbox](knowledge/05-motor-and-gearbox.md): torqueScale before loadMotor, updateMotorProperties, gear groups, automatic shifting, pedals, getCanMotorRun chain, updateVehiclePhysics, braking and parking brake from code
- [6. Consumption, wear, value](knowledge/06-consumption-wear-value.md): fuel usage, Wearable damage and wear setters, repair price (static calculateRepairPrice), calculateSellPrice, getSellPrice composition
- [7. HUD and display](knowledge/07-hud-and-display.md): SpeedMeterDisplay, speedBg, drawControlledEntityHUD, onDrawUIInfo, Overlay/HUDElement, own bars and icons, Vehicle.showInfo, notifications, showBlinkingWarning, EnhancedVehicle overlap
- [8. Helpers (AI)](knowledge/08-helpers-ai.md): getIsAIActive, getJob, stopCurrentAIJob, own AIMessage + aiMessageManager, AutoDrive detection and stopAutoDrive (no AIJob), Courseplay getIsCpActive, onAIJobFinished, stop message follow-ups
- [9. Used vehicle market](knowledge/09-used-vehicle-market.md): VehicleSaleSystem fields, constants, addSale, setSaleItem removes the offer, used condition after spawn, shop cells
- [10. Multiplayer](knowledge/10-multiplayer.md): roles, events, relay with noEventSend and ghost object, admin and farm permission checks, server-authoritative blueprint (validation, response, full resync, join sync, bounded reads), dirty flags, server-only motor values, dedicated server (g_client nil)
- [11. Pitfalls](knowledge/11-pitfalls.md): common mistakes, own and seen in other mods
- [12. Learned from other mods](knowledge/12-learned-from-other-mods.md): per mod (license, link, techniques): AdjustSuite, AutoDrive, Courseplay, UsedPlus, ExtendedLeasing, UniversalAutoload, interactiveControl, EnhancedVehicle, DashboardLive, manualAttach, PowerTools, AdvancedDamageSystem, ExtendedVehicleMaintenance, CVT Addon, RealisticHarvesting, Additional Game Settings, EasyDevelopmentControls, HideHelpTexts, SimpleInspector, FarmTablet, AdjustStorageCapacity, WorkerCosts, ContractBoost, MarketDynamics, guidanceSteering (FS22); compatibility table (getCanMotorRun, startMotor, getSellPrice, repair, updateDamageAmount, torque curve, addMoney)
- [13. Input and player](knowledge/13-input-and-player.md): modDesc actions/inputBinding, axis actions, onRegisterActionEvents, addActionEvent, registerActionEvent, PlayerInputComponent context, short/long press, mouse clicks via project(), g_localPlayer, triggers, attachImplement, PTO, hoses
- [14. Development and debugging](knowledge/14-development-and-debugging.md): addConsoleCommand, consoleCommand* from Lua, restart into savegame (doRestart -autoStartSavegameId), setTimeScale, printTableRecursively, call logger, debug drawing, debug build by file presence, Luau syntax
- [15. Dashboards and vehicle data](knowledge/15-dashboards-and-vehicle-data.md): speed, rpm, temperature, fill units, damage, mass, odometer, differentials, server-only lastFuelUsage, DashboardValueType, onRegisterDashboardValueTypes, DashboardLive forDBL, forDBL_* of CVT Addon, RHM_Api, inspector data loop, publishing a cross-mod API on g_currentMission, FS25_MasterHUD
- [16. Economy, missions, placeables](knowledge/16-economy-missions-and-placeables.md): MoneyType members, booking paths (addMoney vs changeBalance), SellingStation.getEffectiveFillTypePrice, getPricePerLiter, sellFillType, MissionManager constants and mission type data, contract vehicles, placeable storages and capacities (onLoad timing), vehicle fill units and mass
